ATTU: Mr. Heury Yamanaka Mobility Studies Engineer
- Get 1999
Re: Mobility Study Lincoln Highway
Cicero Ave. to Chicago Road
Dear Henry,
The Forest Preserve District issued your Division permission by letter of December 10, 1971, to use a strip 25'x 100' on the north side of Lincoln Highway at Thorn Creek for a temporary working area during the reconstruction of the bridge.
Your current request asks for an additional temporary work area, 50° by 95', to adjust the grade on the District's entrance, west of the Thorn Creek Bridge, to match the new proposed highway profile.

Please submit the necessary indentures so we may present this matter to the Board of Forest Preserve District Commissioners for approval.
It is our opinion that the temporary use will not have any significant effect on the recreational opportunities of the community.
It is required that any areas disturbed by construction work or changes in grade be regraded, topsoiled, fertilized and sodded, and that your contractor post with the District the necessary insurance naming the District as insured or additional insured.
Very truly yours.

Arthur J. Darek
